text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Kitasan Black—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um, I need to talk to you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I worked really hard these past three 
years, didn't I?
choice_data_list: Ah, you really did your best.

text_block_list.text:
I nod without the slightest hesitation. 
She has put in an incredible amount of 
effort, and it has truly paid off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. After pulling off 
this much, even I think I deserve a little 
reward, despite how strict I am with 
myself! So...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it about time we went on that hot 
springs trip? With the ticket we won in 
the raffle, that is.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If just having fun isn't good enough... 
then I'll hold a recital right at the hot 
springs resort!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make all the grandpas and 
grandmas happy! So please!

I stopped Kitasan Black from trying to 
turn it into a serious concert, and we 
decided to just go to the hot springs 
normally.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that bath felt so wonderful~. My 
skin and my spirit are both glowing~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer... hot springs are... 
dangerous places, aren't they...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"That feeling that I always had to keep 
myself together just completely gave way 
all at once. Somehow... somehow today..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I want to let loose and go completely 
wild! Just like a kid!"

She's the "Reliable General" everyone 
always turns to. Perhaps that's precisely 
why she wants to be set free once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you mind if I do whatever I 
want just a little bit today?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't do this in front of anyone 
else, but since it's you, Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Ah, sure. Feel free to relax and do what 
you want.

Yeah, sure. Spend your time however you 
like.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, thank you so much! So please cut me 
some slack if I mess up a little bit, 
okay?

And so, as if released from some burden, 
Kitasan Black began to enjoy herself to 
her heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer~, I stayed in the bath way too 
long~. My head is so dizzy~...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was playing the 'don't get out until 
counting to 1000' game all by myself... 
and then... Haaauuuuu~~~.

I hurriedly brought over a cold towel to 
cool her head. And then...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*burp*... I ate too much~. I usually try 
to hold back so it won't keep me from 
running, but~...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, I want sweets too! I want 
Japanese sweets!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're really fine with this today, 
right?! Are you sure? Don't blame me for 
whatever happens, okay?
choice_data_list: Sure, but make sure you don't fall over.

Sure, but just make sure not to fall over, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Time to dig in! Uji Kintoki avalanche 
with condensed milk, topped with shiratama 
dango~!!

And so, Kitasan Black went all out doing 
whatever she pleased...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whew, hot springs are the absolute best! 
It really feels like... yay, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I could never do something like this on an 
ordinary day, but maybe who I am today is 
the real me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, Trainer! Why don't we do 
the Bon Odori dance now? The Bon Odori!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On stage it's all Western dances, so 
I rarely get to do traditional ones, which 
gets a bit lonely.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please! Come on, pretty please! It'll be 
super fun, I swear! Come on, please?
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll stick with you all the way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaay! As expected of you, Trainer! 
Alright, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yoyoi no yoi! Yoyoi no yoi!

Kitasan Black, who normally never acts 
selfishly, seems so carefree and full of 
joy today, almost like a completely 
different person...

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Kitasan Black...
